units.source_text: 我在观战记中所写的名人的眉毛，是左眉上的一根白毛。

en.t: The eyebrow of the Master that I wrote about in my game commentary was a single white hair on his left eyebrow.

units.source_text: 可是，遗容照片上，右边的眉毛全都显得很长。

en.t: But in the posthumous photograph, all the hairs of the eyebrow on the right side looked very long.

units.source_text: 不至于是名人死后突然长起来的吧。

en.t: Surely they could not have suddenly grown after the Master died.

units.source_text: 名人的眉毛是这样长的吗？

en.t: Were the Master's eyebrows really that long?

units.source_text: 照片夸大了右边眉毛的长度，这确实无疑。

en.t: There is no doubt that the photograph exaggerated the length of the eyebrow on the right side.
